IS 19027 : 2023 Measurement and Control of Sediments in Natural Lakes - Guidelines
ICS 93.160
ICS 93.160
WRD 10
WRD 10
1 SCOPE
This standard lays down guidelines for measurement and control of sedimentation in natural lakes.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contains provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards given below:
